notes: row = [N, type[0..N] (N+1 values), nEvents, events..., channels, queue]. event = [code, args..., nOps, ops...]: 0 TACT(clock), 1 REQUEST(nsfx, pan, att) -> 0x408dd0, 2 STOPALL -> 0x409550, 3 STOPONE(nsfx) -> 0x408d80, 4 PLAYWAV(file, load, ret) -> 0x408c50 (file = name id, load 0 = fopen fails, 1 = opened but no WAV data, 2 = loaded; ret = return value), 5 FINISH(ch) = the non-looping sound of channel ch reached its end (device event, no call). op = [code, args...]: 1 GetStatus(ch, status), 2 SetPan(ch, pan), 3 SetVolume(ch, att), 4 Play(ch, flags), 5 Stop(ch), 6 LOAD(ch, nsfx, src) = CreateSoundBuffer+fill (src -1) or DuplicateSoundBuffer of channel src's buffer, 7 Release(ch), 8 SetCurrentPosition(ch, pos). channels = 8 x [active, hasBuffer, nsfx, time]; queue = [count, count x [index, nsfx, pan, att]] (entries with nsfx >= 0). Channels and queue are read after the last event.
